line.en: This project showcases the transformation of a compact-bedroom townhouse.

brief.en:
The challenge was to maximize openness functionality within a limited floor plan.  Through 
thoughtful space planning, the interiors were reimagined to create a greater sense of flow and spaciousness 
without compromising comfort.  A minimal-chic aesthetic was achieved through the use of warm wood 
finishes, clean lines, and carefully curated materials, resulting in a space that feels both inviting and 
sophisticated.
